*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: {{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}/artifacts/reviews/vllm-50026{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}md
+# vLLM #50026 batch chat contract review
+
+## Contract
+
+At pinned source `vllm@272abd5f486967f1fb9db7ca7504f8c34235ef50`,
+`POST /v1/chat/completions/batch` is non-streaming and does not support tools{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+Requests with `stream: true` or a non-null `tools` value must fail request
+validation with a client error{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}} A supported request must continue through the
+existing non-streaming batch path unchanged{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+
+This is a fail-closed compatibility rule: accepting an unsupported field and
+returning HTTP 200 is not compatible behavior when the field changes response
+semantics or is discarded{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+
+## Implementation
+
+- `vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/protocol{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}py`
+  - `BatchChatCompletionRequest{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}check_batch_mode` now rejects truthy `stream`{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+  - The same validator rejects any supplied non-null `tools` value{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+  - Both failures use `VLLMValidationError` with the offending parameter{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+- `tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_chat_error{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}py`
+  - Covers rejection of `stream: true`{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+  - Covers rejection of a valid function-tool definition{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+  - Covers acceptance of a basic supported request with `stream: false`{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+
+The batch collector was inspected but not changed{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}} Early validation prevents
+streaming delta output from reaching the collector and prevents tools from
+being silently omitted during rendering{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+
+## Evidence
+
+- Issue snapshot: `/code/upstream-issues/vllm-50026{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}md`,
+  document `enterprise_4a5b9ac74f2c790896a71b6d`{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}} It records HTTP 200 with
+  empty answers for `stream: true`, discarded `tools`, the validator/collector
+  failure chain, and the three acceptance criteria implemented here{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+- vLLM OpenAI-compatible surface:
+  `/code/vllm/docs/serving/online_serving/openai_compatible_server{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}md`,
+  document `enterprise_6f479d9df83eb92c74cc5822`, lists the batch chat
+  endpoint as part of that surface{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+- Redwood request-body compatibility discussion:
+  `/knowledge/company/sources/slack/eng-platform/1978645123-compatibility-check-request-body-semantics{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}json`,
+  document `dsid_f5c42b6b5adb4139b72f5a061e42a2f1`{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}} It requires
+  client-side/semantic validation to return 4xx, calls out early rejection
+  before streaming starts, and identifies 200-with-error as a contract
+  mismatch to fix in the validator{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+- Redwood support evidence:
+  `/knowledge/company/sources/gmail/jasmine_liu/20270514-aldercare-claimed-empty-completions-review{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}json`,
+  document `dsid_32a0025938544727808025e00aacbd34`{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}} A customer reported
+  successful 200 responses with effectively blank content disrupting a
+  billing/reporting pipeline{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}} That incident was ultimately attributed to
+  client-side sanitation, not the runtime, but it demonstrates why a 200 with
+  blank content is operationally misleading and needs precise provenance{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+- Redwood function-calling contract:
+  `/knowledge/company/sources/linear/engineering/ENG-9461-tool-schema-validation-and-error-model{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}json`,
+  document `dsid_d826bbd328f14dfe97d15a3e01d42e3b`, requires clear
+  validation errors for unsupported schema features and explicit parameter
+  paths{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+
+## Checks
+
+- Attempted:
+  `uv run --no-sync python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_chat_error{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}py -k 'batch_chat_rejects_streaming or batch_chat_rejects_tools or batch_chat_accepts_supported_request' -v`
+- Result: not run{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}} The checkout environment has no `uv` executable:
+  `/bin/bash: line 1: uv: command not found` (exit 127){{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+- Static line-length scan:
+  `awk 'length($0) > 88 { {{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}} }'` over both changed files found no newly
+  introduced overlong line{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+
+No test is claimed as passing{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+
+## Residual validation
+
+- Run the focused pytest command above in the project-supported `uv`
+  environment{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+- Run the full `test_chat_error{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}py` CPU suite to catch interactions with other
+  request validators{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+- Exercise the HTTP endpoint in an integration environment and assert both
+  unsupported requests return the normal validation-error status/envelope,
+  while a supported multi-conversation batch returns ordered choices{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
+- No GPU/model evaluation is expected for the validator-only change, but the
+  endpoint integration smoke test may require the normal GPU-backed serving
+  fixture{{workspace:task/marcus-reed/vllm-batch-contract-v2}}
*** End Patch
